sentences.text: The ERASE study is a randomized controlled trial conducted at multiple sites that will split 660 patients from seven Chinese stroke centers evenly between a robotic-assisted group and a control group.

Participants in both groups will have their arteries accessed using the Seldinger technique, a method for inserting catheters, within a design where doctors know the treatment but image reviewers do not.
The primary outcomes are the clinical success rate of the procedure and the rate of complications, serious adverse events, and device malfunctions.
Secondary measures include procedural time, radiation dose, and the volume of contrast agent used.
